metric.unit: Unicode codepoint, including English letters; not WER
metric.aggregation: sum counts per round/category, not mean sentence CER
metric.verbatim: exact codepoints, including punctuation, spaces and case
metric.speech-v1: NFKC, lowercase, remove Unicode P* punctuation and whitespace; retain symbols, digits and Chinese numeral differences; no traditional/simplified conversion
metric.tie_break: equal-distance substitution, deletion, insertion in that order

scope: Fixed synthetic eSpeak diagnostics only; no natural speech, representative corpus score, phone/microphone/latency/energy acceptance. Repeated rounds reuse the same clips and do not add independent samples.
resource_scope: Linux Python evaluation process including imports/model; recognizer load excludes prior file hashing; unpaced decoding includes one second zero tail; no handset or end-to-end timing
